# Recovery identity must match idempotency identity
P1 pattern: replacing operation-ID lookup with a first-match resource/workspace scan aliases distinct saves when historical recovery records remain retained. A new operation may then inherit an old completed phase, skip its data write, omit its own audit record, and still be acknowledged under the caller's new ID. Review recovery lookup together with acknowledgment identity and retained history; reproduce with two sequential IDs targeting one resource. Preserve one record per operation ID.
